function.name: run_sql
function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT account_code, period, SUM(amount_cad) AS total_cad FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.gl_balance WHERE account_type='opex' AND account_code \u003c\u003e '6100' AND period IN ('2026-08','2026-09') GROUP BY account_code, period","purpose":"Check OPEX accounts excluding 6100 for Aug and Sep 2026"}
